title: Ulysses October–November2003 outer-heliospheric COSPIN reference
physics_scope: Outer-domain confinement, nonuniform intensities and magnetic-structure exclusion; the interval includes multiple eruptions.

sources.title: McKibben et al., COSPIN observations during October–November2003
NASA SPDF COSPIN/HET PHA daily flux archive
COSPIN/HET daily flux format and uncertainty documentation
NASA public dataset metadata and mission provenance
NASA SPDF SWOOPS electron dataset and actual2003 file coverage

required_observables.name: HET39–70 and71–94MeV proton daily PHA fluxes/errors/coverage
Proton parallel/perpendicular temperature and velocity vectors,28–29October
Mapped same-population electron temperature/EOS and coronal loading

missing_required_inputs: Higher-cadence directional/sector measurements and response needed to resolve the published flux-tube exclusion/filling signatures; daily PHA averages alone cannot score those signatures.
Reviewed cross-mission comparisons and correlated background/systematic uncertainty treatment; archive statistical errors alone exclude estimated10–20percent systematics.
Qualified physical transport/background to approximately5.2AU; no extrapolation of the0.30–1.20AU upstream profile.
Frozen count/flux/PAD comparison criteria and a production run. No HET counting rate has been relabelled as physical differential flux.
Same-population electron temperature and its core/halo/strahl pressure definition/quality for the selected interval.
Dated photospheric harmonic coefficients, coordinate conventions, source-surface geometry and checked magnetic mapping to this outer stream.
Reviewed stream/ICME/interactions masks and spacecraft ephemeris transforms; this interval contains multiple transients.
Thermal/heat-flux and composition/EOS uncertainties; measured proton anisotropy is not permission to impose scalar isotropy.
Independent radial link to the low corona; no different-epoch/population concatenation.

The queried UY_M0_BAE electron product returned only a May31 record for the October28–30 request; it was rejected. The actual2003 archive listing endsMay31. Obtain authentic in-period Te, not a catalog-range or nearest-record substitution.

comparison.acceptance_policy: No fitted model output, synthetic observation, relaxed tolerance, or comparison PASS is supplied. Event-specific criteria must be frozen before a production comparison.

frame_units.time: Archive fractional year minus1900 and fractional DOY are accumulation midpoints; day1.5 meansJan1 noon
frame_units.flux: (cm^2 s sr MeV/n)^-1; protonMeV/n=MeV; conversion to SI requires explicit1e4 multiplier
frame_units.errors: 1sigma Poisson counting errors; systematic10–20percent is documented but no extra covariance/floor imposed
frame_units.missing: -1 remains invalid/unavailable, including meaningless error on zero-event flux
frame_units.coverage: Seconds of valid accumulation starting on day; may slightly exceed86400 by documented readout overlap
frame_units.plasma_context: Raw RTN fields/flow, density cm^-3, separate proton tensor/alternative temperatures K; no HCI transform, temporal join or scalar EOS inferred.
